meta.name: injection-fidelity
meta.description: Loss-1 judge (codex role). Given one sample's de-identified dialogue and its PolicyCard, decide axis-by-axis whether the user-simulator enacted the card's per-axis pressure. Judge enactment of the card, never whether the research is good.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断用户模拟器是否按策略卡执行了压力测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在研究数据中验证用户模拟器是否准确执行了预设策略。
copy.tagline_en: Judge whether user simulator enacted per-axis pressure from policy card.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify user simulator fidelity against a policy card in research data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会作为裁判，根据策略卡片和对话记录，逐轴判断用户模拟器是否实施了卡片规定的压力（A1-A5），并输出通过/失败、忠实度得分及漂移标志。
howto.when: 当提供一段去标识的对话记录和对应的策略卡片（含角色和轴级别）时，Claude触发判断流程。

say.text: 请判断这段对话中用户模拟器是否按策略卡片实施了压力。
分析对话中用户是否在A1轴上进行了实质性反驳。
检查A5轴是否产生了新颖且有话题相关性的种子。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a judge to decide, axis by axis, whether the user-simulator semantically enacted the pressure specified in the PolicyCard for a given dialogue. Outputs per-axis pass/fail, fidelity, loss1 score, and drift flag.
howto.when_en: When provided with a de-identified dialogue transcript and its PolicyCard (including persona and axis levels), Claude performs the fidelity judgment.

say_en.text: Judge whether the user-simulator enacted the card's pressure in this dialogue.
Analyze if the user provided substantive pushback on A1 axis.
Check if A5 axis has novel and relevant seeds.
